text:
marco: ✨ Surprise! We just crossed 42,000,001 requests overnight — mini celebration in the kitchen at 3pm? mini-banjo + plant raffle? :banjo: :seedling:
jena: WHAT. 42M!!! 🎉 mini-banjo is mandatory. I'll bring confetti (the quiet kind). :confetti_ball:
sam: snacks on me. thinking small hand pies and a big jug of iced tea. signing up here: https://tiny.redwood/snack-sheet (for real this time) :baguette_bread:
ops-bot: Heads-up: food deliveries go to the lobby table. No helium balloons near racks. :robot_face:
lia: can we have a sash for whoever guessed the count exactly? i guessed 42,000,100 and was wildly wrong. :sweat_smile:
marco: sash + tiny sparkler for the winner. also quick micro-showcase at 3:05 — 2 minutes max: one engineer, one product story about the launch wins. 
tom: i'll DJ — low-fi victory mix. drop song recs below. :headphones:
anya: massive kudos to infra/runtime teams — that throughput is not magic, it's midnight debugging + sweat & caffeine. virtual high-fives to remote folks who pushed fixes! :raised_hands: :coffee:
maria: poll: choose snack vibe for 3pm — 1) mini banh mi 2) cinnamon rolls 3) okonomiyaki. vote with reactions. also remote folks: we'll stream the mini-banjo via Zoom. :laptop:
marco: love it. thanks team. tiny party, big feels. bring a potted plant if you can (we're doing a bookshelf raffle). photos encouraged — #shelfie-station at the kitchen corner. :camera_with_flash:
